regulations.notes: Sarasota enacted a vacation rental registration ordinance (Ordinance 25-5560) requiring all 1-4 family dwelling units in Residential zones to obtain a Certificate of Registration. The registration process includes inspection and approval. There is a 7-day minimum stay requirement and occupancy caps. Registration applications opened in October 2024; operations without a certificate became illegal in 2025.
